name: Motif
description: Personal theme system by Ege Çelikçi. Single source of truth for the palette and semantics shared by the website, Forgejo and Navidrome.

semantics.primary: brand accent: links, primary buttons, focus

accessibility.rule: Every text/background pair a target ships must meet normalText; UI borders and non-text indicators must meet largeTextAndUI.
accessibility.knownIssue: The website's textMuted (#5b6a9a light) is only 4.17:1 on surface. Targets must darken muted text rather than copy the raw value; see forgejo/motif-*.css.

website.mechanism: SCSS custom properties; light in :root, dark in @mixin dark-palette
website.note: Currently the de-facto origin of this palette. Not yet consuming this repo.

forgejo.mechanism: CSS override fragments appended to stock Forgejo themes at build time
forgejo.note: Installed by services/forgejo in the nixos config.

navidrome.mechanism: MUI theme object compiled into the UI bundle (requires patching the Navidrome build)
navidrome.note: Navidrome cannot load external theme files.
